access.title: You cannot open RFQs & sourcing
access.body: Reading sample and development orders needs the right to see purchase orders (purchasing.view). An administrator of your company can give it to you.

band.label: RFQs & sourcing
band.exportHint: From the list: Export ▾ in its toolbar, or Export N with rows selected.

samples.title: Sample and development orders
samples.note: Sample hides, swatches and colour cards for a style or a sample round: not counted in production spend, and never planned against production.
samples.failed: Couldn’t load sample and development orders

row.pdfSent: The PDF as it was sent to the supplier (a new tab)
row.pdfDraft: The draft as the supplier would get it today (a new tab)

list.noneFilteredHint: Change the words or the status, or clear the filters.
list.empty: Buy sample hides, swatches and colour cards for a style or a sample round: they stay apart from production buying.

new.title: New sample order
new.foot: A draft purchase order of type Sample: prices, the PDF and the send are on its record.
new.choicesFailed: Couldn’t load what a sample order can name
new.incomplete: Some lists are longer than shown: type more of a name to find it, or ask an administrator to archive what is no longer used.

field.styleHint: The style in development the samples are for.
field.roundHint: An open sample round of the style, or none: for the style alone.
field.roundNone: The style has no open sample round: the order is for the style alone.
field.requestedHint: Optional: the day you would like the samples.
field.materialHide: Only leathers: a sample hide is a hide.
field.descriptionHint: After the sample words on the line (“20 × 20 cm”).

lines.title: What it buys
lines.hint: Each line says to the supplier what it is (sample hide, swatch, colour card) in the supplier’s language.

held.manage: Drafting a sample order needs the right to manage purchase orders (purchasing.manage).
held.company: Choose a company first: a sample order is made by one company.
held.choices: Wait until the suppliers, styles and materials are read.
held.style: Choose the style the samples are for.
held.requestedPast: The day wanted is today or later.
held.lineMaterial: Choose the material of every line.
held.lineUnit: Choose the unit of every line.
held.lineQuantity: Give every line a quantity above 0 (at most four decimals).
held.lineDate: Give every line the day it is needed.
held.linePast: Every line is needed today or later.
held.maxLines: At most 20 lines here: add more on the order’s record.
held.lastLine: A sample order has at least one line.
held.pdfCost: The PDF prints the prices: it needs the cost rights.

refusal.NOT_A_SAMPLE_ORDER: This order is not a sample order.
refusal.STYLE_CLOSED: This style is archived or discontinued: no samples are bought for it.
refusal.ROUND_CLOSED: This sample round is decided or cancelled: buy for an open round, or for the style alone.
refusal.ROUND_OF_ANOTHER_STYLE: This sample round is another style’s: choose a round of the style.
refusal.HIDE_NOT_LEATHER: A sample hide is a hide of a leather: choose a leather, or say it is a swatch or a colour card.
refusal.NOT_A_MATERIAL: A sample order buys materials, never a finished garment.
refusal.SAMPLE_ORDER_TAKES_NO_PLAN_LINES: A sample order takes no lines of the plan or of a request: they go on a production order.

invalid.partyId: This supplier cannot take an order now: choose another.
invalid.siteId: This site cannot take deliveries: choose another.
invalid.developmentStyleId: This style is not one of your company’s.
invalid.sampleRoundId: This sample round is not one of your company’s.
invalid.requestedDate: The day wanted is today or later.
invalid.note: The words for the supplier are too long.
invalid.contactId: The supplier’s contact cannot take orders.

line.itemId: This material cannot be bought: choose another.
line.itemColourId: Choose an active colour of the material.
line.quantity: A quantity above 0, at most four decimals.
line.uom: The material is not bought in this unit: choose one of its units.
line.needDate: The day it is needed is today or later.
line.unitPrice: The price is not one this line can take.

problem.read: The list could not be read. Try again in a moment.
problem.write: The draft could not be made. Try again in a moment.
problem.invalid: Something in the draft was refused: check the fields.
problem.conflict: Something changed meanwhile: read again and try once more.
problem.gone: It is no longer there: read again.
problem.forbidden: Your rights do not allow this.
problem.signedOut: Your session ended: sign in again.
problem.slowDown: Too many tries: wait a moment.
problem.offline: No answer from the server: check the connection and try again.

notice.draftedNext: Check its prices, then send it from its record (the PDF goes with the mail).
